_doc: Bars and the night economy. Each bar sits on a raft platform (community + platform) as a 'bar' structure. open = [from, to] hours (wraps midnight); busy = hour the crowd peaks. drinks: id -> {name, price, cur, strength 0..1, mood, homebrew (smuggling product), banned (Highmark tax/ban), desc}. bartender: a person with memory (visits, tab, favours) and a dialogue tree: nodes with text (may use {name}, {tab}, {visits}) and options [{text, go | do, if, ifNot, cost}]. do = order | rumour | game:<id> | tab | confess | leave | job | door. regulars: people who drink here, with a line or two and what they can lead to. band: procedural style (shanty, garden, forge, hymn, smoke, lounge). games: house games available. vice: per-drink addiction weight and hangover. mature: true marks content that has a clean alternative (see mature in data). All text is original to this world.

rum_ration.name: Ration Rum
rum_ration.desc: Highmark-bonded. Tastes like a promise somebody else made.

bilge_gin.name: Bilge Gin
bilge_gin.desc: Distilled in a pressure cooker on a raft nobody will name. Tastes like a fire in a rope shop.

salt_beer.name: Salt Beer
salt_beer.desc: Thin, cloudy, honest. Brewed from ration barley and spite.

kelp_wine.name: Kelp Wine
kelp_wine.desc: Green-gold. It shouldn't be good. It is.

greenwater.name: Greenwater
greenwater.desc: Seaweed spirit, triple-run. The Greentide elders pretend not to know who makes it.

sour_tide.name: Sour Tide
sour_tide.desc: Fermented plum from the last plum tree in Orrin Bay. Everybody knows exactly which tree.

slag.name: Slag
slag.desc: Rusthold's own. Served in a welding cup. You don't sip Slag, you survive it.

coolant.name: Coolant
coolant.desc: Blue. Not actual coolant. Mostly not actual coolant.

tea_still.name: Still Water Tea
tea_still.desc: Free at the Vigil. It tastes of smoke and somebody's grandmother.

tea_bitter.name: Bitterleaf
tea_bitter.desc: Keeps you awake through a night watch and through most conversations.

fog_gin.name: Fog Gin, no ice, stirred twice
fog_gin.desc: The drink is fine. The order is a password.

drowned_rat.name: A Drowned Rat
drowned_rat.desc: Black rum, bitter salt, a lime that came from somewhere it shouldn't have.

gold_seal.name: Gold Seal Reserve
gold_seal.desc: Highmark's luxury brandy, sold to raft-folk at a 'heritage discount'. The bottle has a picture of the Chancellor smiling at it.

bars.name: The Brass Anchor
bars.blurb: Loud, hot, packed. A bargaining pit in the middle where traders shout prices at each other like it's a sport. It is a sport.

bartender.name: Haddie Brass
bartender.intro: You're new. New drinks first round at full price. That's not a rule, I just like it.

options.text: What's the word on the water?

games.text: Quill's on the cards. Bones by the pit if you like dice. And if you've got a stomach, the boys are doing Last Rope at the back.

work.text: You can carry crates, you can pour, or you can keep your mouth shut for money. Which of those are you good at?

options.text: Keep my mouth shut? I'm listening.

greets: Back again. The Anchor always gets them back.
Wipe your boots. No, I'm joking, the floor's been sticky since the flood.
You look like you've been arguing with the sea. Who won?
greetsTab: Your tab's at {tab}. I'm not saying anything. I'm just saying the number.
greetsRegular: {visits} nights. You're furniture now. I'm going to start polishing you.

regulars.name: Quill Marrow
lines: Tide Cards is a game of skill. Mostly the skill of knowing when to leave.
I never cheat. I simply remember better than everyone else, out loud, with my hands.

regulars.name: Lumi Vale
lines: Hi! Do you want to be in my broadcast? Just hold this Gold Seal and say 'heritage' with your eyes.
Highmark sends me one free crate a week to say rations are 'a lifestyle'. It's honestly so empowering.
Don't film my left side. That's my 'pre-flood' side.

regulars.name: Dockmother Ree
lines: The Calla Morrow sang the night she sank. Didn't hear it? Course you didn't. You weren't drowning.
Buy an old woman a drink and she'll tell you where the Ward don't look.

regulars.name: Bruno Tack
lines: You looking at me or the wall behind me? Choose carefully.
I used to be a lifeguard. Then the whole world needed one.

rumours: A Highmark supply barge runs the east channel every fifth night. Two guards and a captain who drinks.
Somebody's been forging ration seals so good the Ward's started weighing them.
There's a hatch at the bottom of the old lighthouse. People go down and come back dressed better.
Lumi Vale's crate last week had real oranges. Nobody's seen an orange since the Rise.
Rusthold's Syndicate wants a pilot who doesn't ask what's in the hold.

bars.name: The Fermentary
bars.blurb: A garden under glass and tarp. Jars of things fermenting along every shelf, gently. People talk quietly here because the plants are listening (they are not).

bartender.name: Sorrel Ndiaye
bartender.intro: Sit anywhere the moss isn't. Kelp wine is this year's. Greenwater is from a year we don't talk about.

still.text: Nobody. It condenses out of the air on certain nights. If a Ward officer asks, it's vinegar. If you want to carry a crate of 'vinegar' to Portage, Haddie pays well.

greets: The weather's turning. You can taste it in the wine.
You found us again. Good. People who find us twice usually stay.
Mind the jar by your elbow. It's older than both of us.
greetsTab: You owe the garden {tab}. The garden is patient. I'm less patient.

regulars.name: Old Juniper
lines: There's a seed in my pocket from before the Rise. I'll plant it when I'm sure there's a world to plant it in.

regulars.name: Teagan Moss
lines: I wrote the ration jingles. 'Order and supply.' Yeah. That was me. I'm drinking about it.

rumours: The Greentide still runs on the full moon. The Ward pretends it's fog.
There's a Highmark auditor who trades seed counts for Greenwater. Cheap man. Very thirsty.
Somebody saw lanternfish making a pattern under the old lighthouse. Three short, one long.

bars.name: The Hot Rivet
bars.blurb: A counter made of a steel I-beam that's still warm from the forge next door. Sparks fall from the ceiling as decoration. Arm-wrestling table by the door, scarred like a butcher's block.

bartender.name: Big Marta Kowal
bartender.intro: Slag or Coolant. Don't ask what's in them. Don't touch the counter, it's hot. Do arm-wrestle me, I'm bored.

work.text: Syndicate pays for hulls, engines and pilots who don't scream. You got a boat? You got nerve? Pick one and come back with the other.

greets: Sit. Not there. That stool bites.
You again. Good. The last one cried.
Sparks are free. Everything else costs.
greetsTab: {tab} scrap. I've broken arms for less. Not yours. Yet.
greetsRegular: {visits} nights. The Pipe Choir wrote you a song. It's mostly clanging.

regulars.name: Jax Fontaine
lines: Every boat in Orrin Bay has a little Rusthold in it. Sometimes a lot. Sometimes a bomb.

regulars.name: Off-Duty Warden Pike
lines: I'm not here. You're not here. Buy me a Slag and we both stay not here.
Patrols change shift at the second bell. Twenty minutes where nobody watches the east channel. You didn't hear that.

rumours: The Syndicate's building a boat that can outrun a Ward interceptor. Hydrofoil. Stolen plans.
Warden Pike drinks here on his off nights. He's cheaper than a lawyer.
Somebody's been melting down Highmark padlocks and selling them back to Highmark.

bars.name: The Quiet Cup
bars.blurb: A candlelit tea house on the Vigil. No alcohol, no raised voices. People come here to say things out loud once, to someone who won't repeat them.

bartender.name: Brother Amon
bartender.intro: Tea is free. Sitting is free. Talking is free. Leaving is free. We are terrible at business.

options.text: I want to say something. Just once.
Is there anything I should know?
I'll sit a while, then go.

help.text: Then you've already done the hard part, which is noticing. Come and sit with us at the second bell. No speeches. Just people, and tea, and nobody pretending.

greets: Welcome. Your shoulders are up by your ears. Put them down.
Sit. The candle doesn't mind who you are.
The sea is loud tonight. In here, it isn't.
greetsTab: There is no tab here. There never will be.
greetsRegular: You've come {visits} times. You're one of the quiet ones now.

regulars.name: Ash Okonkwo
lines: I light one lantern a night for everyone I lost. It takes a while.

regulars.name: A Tideholder
lines: The Vigil holds what the city drops. Debts. Secrets. Children. We are very good at holding things.
If you owe Lowlight, we can talk to Lowlight. Quietly.

rumours: The Tideholders keep a ledger of every debt in the Drift. Even Highmark's.
Someone confessed to being on the Calla Morrow the night she sank. The Vigil kept it.
There is a woman who runs a place under the water. She comes to the Vigil once a year, masked, and lights a lantern.

bars.name: The Drowned Rat
bars.blurb: Fog inside and out. Low ceiling, painted ships on every surface, a bookcase that is very obviously a door. Smugglers drink here because the Ward can't find it twice.

bartender.name: Mister Fenn
bartender.intro: You found the Rat. Congratulations. Most people find the bottom of the channel first.

options.text: Fog gin, no ice. Stirred twice.

greets: You again. Sit with your back to the wall like everyone else.
Keep your voice under the saw.
greetsTab: You owe the Rat {tab}. The Rat remembers. I'm the Rat.
greetsRegular: {visits} nights. People here are starting to forget you're not one of us. That's a compliment.

regulars.name: Vesna Kade
lines: I've outrun the Ward forty-one times. Forty-two if you count the time I was technically in a fridge.

regulars.name: Silent Mo
lines: (He slides you a ration seal. It's perfect. He takes it back.)

rumours: The coded channel says 'three short, one long' every night at the second bell. Under the lamp, they say.
Ask Fenn for a fog gin, no ice, stirred twice. If he likes you, the bookcase opens.
There's a Highmark family running guns out of the Concord. They call themselves the Sundials.

tide_cards.name: Tide Cards
tide_cards.desc: High-low with a deck of salvaged playing cards. Call the next card higher or lower; keep going to double, or bank it.

bones.name: Bones
bones.desc: Three knuckle-bones. Beat the house's roll.

last_rope.name: Last Rope
last_rope.desc: A drinking game. Drink when the rope creaks. The last one standing takes the pot (and the hangover).

bargain_pit.name: The Bargaining Pit
bargain_pit.desc: Shout a price at the right moment. Too early and you're a mark; too late and someone else wins.

arm_wrestle.name: Arm-Wrestling
arm_wrestle.desc: Tap in rhythm to hold your arm; push when the opponent tires.

seed_count.name: Seed Count
seed_count.desc: Guess the seeds in the jar. Win a cutting. Lose nothing.

pour.name: Work a shift behind the bar
pour.desc: Pour drinks, take abuse, overhear everything.

quiet.name: Hold a package overnight
quiet.desc: Somebody's package. Somebody else's problem. Yours until morning.

vinegar.name: Carry 'vinegar' to Portage
vinegar.desc: A crate of Greenwater to Haddie at the Brass Anchor. If the Ward stops you, it's vinegar.

syndicate.name: Syndicate engine run
syndicate.desc: Engine parts to Lowlight, the long way round.

lowlight.name: Fog run
lowlight.desc: A sealed bag to a stall in Portage. Don't open it.

forgery.name: Paper for Mo
forgery.desc: Blank seal stock lifted off a Highmark clerk. Mo needs it before the moon's down.

tideholder.name: Carry a debt-letter
tideholder.desc: A letter that forgives somebody's debt. Lowlight will not like reading it.

crowdLines: —and I said, mate, that's not a fish, that's your boot.
Highmark's raising the salt tax again. On salt. On the sea!
Two scrap says she wins. Three says she breaks his arm.
Have you heard Lumi's new jingle? I can't get it out of my head. I've tried a nail.
Don't drink the gin. No, drink the gin, just not the green gin.
My cousin swears she saw lights under the Sounding again.
Another round for the table that isn't paying!
Ward boat went past an hour ago. Searchlight and everything. Very pretty.
He sold me a map to the Cathedral. It was a menu.
If the Concord's so glamorous why do they all smell like mildew and cologne?

starts: Somebody throws a stool. Somebody else throws the person who threw the stool.
A card falls out of a sleeve. The table goes quiet, then very loud.
Two dockhands disagree about whose turn it was to be wrong.
outcomes: You catch an elbow and taste copper. The bartender pours you one on the house for 'stopping a stool with your face'.
You stay out of it. Mostly. Your drink doesn't survive.
You end it with one good shove. People buy you drinks. The bouncer writes your name down.

hangover: Your head is a bell somebody is still ringing.
You remember the first half of the night. The second half is a rumour.
